answer.diagnosis: Forward forms powers and squared powers in the input dtype before reduction. This permits rounding and overflow before normalization. Actual poly-02 GPU output has 23,541/32,768 mismatches, maximum absolute error 6.927851837797153, and no nonfinite outputs. The same-width fp32 control poly-03 passes all 32,768 outputs; the smaller fp16 control also passes. These observations implicate intermediate precision but do not establish which intermediate first overflows. Promote forward arithmetic to fp64 before forming powers: even sixth powers of finite fp32/bf16 inputs fit in fp64, whereas promotion to fp32 alone would not cover the stated input range. Accumulate the weighted result in fp64 and retain the existing output store conversion, shape, and input preservation. The backward cache and backward implementation remain unchanged. This prioritizes correctness over throughput; compilation, performance, and held-out correctness could not be verified through the supplied API.
